'''Tan Yuster'''<ref name="Lightsabers" /> was a [[human]]<ref name="AOC" /> who was the [[Padawan]] learner of the [[Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Agen Kolar]]. The two were among the [[Jedi assault team]] that accompanied [[Mace Windu]] on the [[First Battle of Geonosis|mission]] to [[Geonosis]] that started the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="Lightsabers" /> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Yuster was [[Death|felled]] in combat while facing an overwhelming number of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s in the Geonosian [[Petranaki Arena]]. Kolar salvaged his fallen [[Tan Yuster's lightsaber|apprentice's lightsaber]] and kept its [[kyber crystal]], which he added to his [[Agen Kolar's lightsaber|own weapon]] in tribute to Yuster.<ref name="Lightsabers" /> After the battle, fellow Padawan [[Thirteenth Sister|Iskat Akaris]] reflected on the Order's losses when she realized that she had not seen Yuster, [[Lumas]] or [[Galdos Stouff]] since then.<ref name="Red Blade">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Tan Yuster had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="AOC" />

==Equipment==
Tan Yuster had a blue-bladed [[lightsaber]] and wore [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
